primaryMetrics: Non-branded search clicks using the fixed exclusion regex
Qualified website inquiries, assessed by owner
Organic-attributed qualified inquiries only where source is known
qualifiedDefinition: Unique, non-spam inquiry for an offered service in the service area, with a stated transaction need and enough information for an advisor follow-up. Owner confirms business qualification; budget or purchase readiness is not inferred from a pageview.
deduplication: Owner deduplicates repeat inquiries about the same opportunity within reporting window; supply aggregate counts only.
cadence: Manual weekly review, then compare complete 28-day periods. No automatic monitoring scheduled.

firstPostLaunchWindow.note: Includes the October 4 initial release and SEO follow-up published at 15:31 Pacific. Wait until GSC data for the full window is available; do not isolate the effects of these same-day releases.

comparison: Use same property, Web (text), country/device scope and brand regex.
Report absolute click change; do not calculate percentage growth against zero for page-level baseline.
Report impressions, position and CTR alongside clicks; compare relevant restaurant/Type 47 query groups separately from irrelevant queries.
Do not equate Search Console clicks to sessions or claim causal attribution from before/after alone.
Qualified-inquiry counts remain unavailable until owner supplies aggregates; do not call a conversion rate valid without matched attribution and denominator.
tracking: No new analytics account, tracking code, consent changes or lead-field changes. Existing Cloudflare visitor analytics retained.
dataLimits: Historical search queries cannot be connected to individual customers using this data.

releaseAnnotations.description: Restaurant-sale content, Type 47 accuracy correction and internal linking revisions deployed.
